proposed_comments.title: Reject completions from a replaced SourceRequested handler
proposed_comments.body:
### Reject completions from a replaced SourceRequested handler

**Severity:** `medium`

The request captures the handler before awaiting, but the stale-completion guard only checks the request version and source key. If a subscriber is replaced while the old handler is still in flight, the old completion can overwrite the icon produced by the current handler. Include the captured handler in the guard.

```suggestion
            if (requestVersion != iconBox._requestVersion ||
                !ReferenceEquals(sourceKey, iconBox.SourceKey) ||
                !ReferenceEquals(sourceRequested, iconBox._sourceRequested))
```

confidence.rationale: The changed code captures sourceRequested before await, but the current stale check does not verify that the captured delegate remains current.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve IconBox request diagnostics for ETW-only sessions
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve IconBox request diagnostics for ETW-only sessions

**Severity:** `medium`

When an external ETW listener is attached without starting a text-report session, `IsRecording` remains false even though `BeginRequest` can create the hidden ETW diagnostics session. `IconBox` therefore skips request, origin, provider-resolution, and demand-attribution events. Include the EventSource-enabled state in the `RequestIconFromSource` diagnostics gate so ETW-only traces retain the same request attribution as text-report sessions.

confidence.rationale: The diagnostics layer creates a hidden session for an enabled EventSource, but IconBox bypasses BeginRequest unless text recording is active.
